articles.title: Road worker dead after being struck by dump truck in Pickering: police
articles.summary: A road worker has died after being struck by a dump truck in Pickering, Ont., Monday, Durham police say.

articles.title: Road worker killed after being struck by dump truck in Pickering
articles.summary: A 31-year-old road worker has died after being struck by a reversing dump truck at a road construction site in Pickering, Durham police say. Officers were called to the area of Peter Matthews Drive and Alexander Knox Drive at approximately 2:40 p.m. on Monday for a pedestrian-involved collision. articles.summary: A former junior hockey executive in Alberta has been charged with sexually exploiting three players. Tyler King, 39, was arrested Friday at a U.S. border crossing in Ontario, RCMP announced Monday. He had been working with the State University of New York campus at Oswego in New York state. articles.title: Toronto hoping to negotiate new deal with Ontario amid financial uncertainty
articles.summary: Fresh from her election victory, Toronto Mayor Olivia Chow is preparing to try and convince Ontario Premier Doug Ford to sign a new agreement with her city. Toronto officials are hoping for a deal with the province that includes long-term funding for city hall.

articles.title: Man dead, SIU investigating after overnight incident at U of T Mississauga: police
articles.summary: Police say one person has been found dead and a shelter-in-place order that was issued late Monday has been lifted after officers responded to a dangerous weapons call at a University of Toronto dormitory in Mississauga.

articles.title: Hundreds of food delivery drivers protest downtown to demand dignity, fair pay from employers
articles.summary: Hundreds of delivery drivers gathered at a protest in downtown Toronto on Monday to demand that their employers provide dignity and fair pay.

articles.title: Man charged in 401 crash in Mississauga that left 2 dead in July, OPP says
articles.summary: A Mississauga man has been charged in a crash on Highway 401 that left two people dead and three injured in July, Ontario Provincial Police say.

articles.title: Inside man or scapegoat? Defence, prosecutors make closing submissions in Pearson airport gold heist trial
articles.summary: Was a then-Air Canada employee an inside man who helped carry out one of the biggest gold heists in Canadian history, or a scapegoat exploited by a longtime friend? Those were the two competing scenarios presented to a Brampton, Ont., court Monday as prosecutors and defence lawyers made their closing submissions in the trial of Parmpal Sidhu.

articles.title: Man faces impaired driving charges after fiery crash in Whitby leaves woman dead
articles.summary: A driver is facing impaired driving charges after a fiery collision on Highway 401 on Sunday left a woman dead, police say.

articles.title: Garden suite built under new Toronto city planning rules upsets neighbours
articles.summary: Fed up with what she calls a violation of her backyard privacy, an East York woman is going public with her campaign to have new garden suites limited to just one storey.
